c.name: Source Opacity
c.expr: fadeInDuration = thisComp.frameDuration * effect("Fade In+Out - frames")(1);fadeOutDuration = thisComp.frameDuration * effect("Fade In+Out - frames")(2);fadeInOpacity = linear(time, inPoint, inPoint+fadeInDuration+0.001, 0, 100);fadeOutOpacity = linear(time, outPoint-fadeOutDuration-0.001, outPoint, 100, 0);(fadeInOpacity * fadeOutOpacity) / 100

PEDG.why: Deep Glow (a third-party plug-in) is not installed, so the captions use After Effects' own Glow instead (close, but not identical). Install Deep Glow for the exact look.
